input.body:
Dear Imogen,

Thank you for your message about the leaking conservatory roof at Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 0ZZ (your current reference R/PM024-2 relates to the oven).

I can't see an open repair request for the conservatory roof on our system, so I'd like to log it properly now. Please could you reply with a short description of the leak: where the water is coming in, how much (drips or steady flow), roughly when you first reported it, and a photo if you can.

In the meantime, please place a bucket or towels under the drip, move belongings away from the wet area, and keep electrical items and sockets away from any water. If water is reaching lights or sockets, or is coming in heavily, please don't touch them, switch off that circuit at the fuse box only if it is safe to do so, and call us straight away.

We'll pick this up as soon as we hear from you, and will chase you on 28 August if we haven't.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
